lines.trans: Everything goes very badly with Sandrine Kiberlain.
What is happening on her shoot?
She wants to abandon Thompson's film.
Do not panic, you will fix that.
She wants to do stand-up now!
Breathe Gabriel, everything will go well.
And you, how is your life going?
I manage my life all alone.
Is it not too hard with Flora?
It is like hiking in flip-flops!
But the baby is doing well here?
Yes, she is very calm today.
Wait, where did my daughter go?
Damn, I forgot her at the photocopier!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
on va arranger ça = we'll sort this out

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of

examples.text: Elle a une tête de bébé.

meanings.note: always masculine, even for a girl
une rue calme = a quiet street
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
comment ça va? = how are you?

meanings.note: un côté positif: a bright side

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus
pour faire quoi? = to do what?

examples.trans: I want to see my daughter.

meanings.note: une petite fille = a little girl
c'est moi qui gère = I'm handling it
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Je ne veux pas te faire de mal.
examples.trans: I don't want to hurt you.

meanings.note: faire du mal à quelqu'un = to hurt someone
exclamation of anger or frustration; also used informally to wish good luck before a show

examples.text: Oh merde, j'ai oublié mes clés.
examples.trans: Oh damn, I forgot my keys.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.trans: Samuel forgot to teach you tenacity.

meanings.en: oublier de + infinitive = to forget to

examples.trans: Can I give you my papers?

examples.trans: It is like hiking in flip-flops!

examples.trans: A nice hike in the mountains on the weekend.

meanings.note: before the noun: le seul agent
